title: Guidelines for Marking Out Designated Smoking Areas within Orchard Road's No Smoking Zones
what_it_is: Guidelines for Marking Out Designated Smoking Areas within Orchard Road's No Smoking Zones

sections.label: Designated Smoking Area marking guidelines
sections.summary: NEA published DSA guidelines requiring clear boundaries, received one feedback on Orchard Road markings, and checked all DSAs there.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The National Environment Agency (NEA) has published guidelines on the setting up of Designated Smoking Areas (DSAs) on its website.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Under the guidelines, premises owners are to ensure that DSA boundaries must be clearly defined using floor stickers or other forms of permanent marking.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: In the past year, NEA received one instance of feedback regarding the clarity of markings demarcating a DSA within the Orchard Road No Smoking Zone.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA has since conducted checks on the condition of all DSAs within the No Smoking Zone and engaged premises owners to make any necessary rectifications.

sections.label: Legislated DSA criteria and Orchard Road
sections.summary: Smoking Regulations 2018 legislate DSA boundary demarcation, signage and a disposal receptacle; Orchard Road has 54 demarcated DSAs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, for certain critical requirements, it is actually legislated in the Smoking (Prohibition in Certain Places) Regulations 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Three of the criteria which are legislated are: firstly, it is about the boundary – that the DSA must be clearly demarcated with suitable measures; secondly, it is about the sign – there must be a signage provided either near or within the DSA to say that this is a Designated Smoking Area; and thirdly, you would need to provide at least one disposal receptacle – cigarette butt canister or litter bin with ash tray – within the DSA.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In the Orchard Road No Smoking Zone, there are currently 54 demarcated DSAs, 100 to 200 metres between DSAs, three DSAs are temporarily closed, and six are demarcated with planter boxes.

sections.label: Enforcement and appeal process
sections.summary: Enforcement action is taken for smoking in prohibited areas, and offenders may appeal to NEA with supporting reasons for consideration.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As regard to enforcement action, if we observe the smoker holding a lit cigarette or smoking in a non-smoking area or smoking prohibited area, enforcement action will be taken.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But the offender can appeal, write into NEA with supporting reasons and we will carefully consider the appeal, taking into account the facts of the case to see it there are mitigating factors for leniency to be accorded.
